channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Thirteen people were killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon. Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.

item.title: China rejects U.S. sanctions on refineries over Iran oil links
item.description: China rejected U. S. sanctions on refineries over Iran oil links, calling them improper and a violation of international law. The Commerce Ministry said Chinese enterprises have the right to conduct normal economic activities with third countries.

item.title: US threatens shipping firms with sanctions if they pay Iran tolls
item.description: The U. S. warned shipping firms they could face sanctions for paying Iran tolls to safely pass through the Strait of Hormuz. President Donald Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Iran's latest peace deal proposal.

item.title: Iran military official says renewed war with U.S. 'likely'
item.description: A senior Iranian military official said renewed war with the U. S. is likely. The official's comments come as the U. S. warns shipping companies about sanctions for payments to Iran.

item.title: Ukraine’s Drone War Has Already Rewritten NATO’s Future
item.description: Ukraine's drone warfare has led NATO to reassess its future military strategies. Kyiv's use of drones has forced NATO to rethink its approach to defense and counterattack capabilities. Ukraine’s Drone War Has Already Rewritten NATO’s Future Kyiv Post.

item.title: How Germany May Have Misjudged Trump’s Anger on Iran
item.description: Germany underestimated President Trump's anger over Iran, offering a measured response after he announced troop withdrawals. Berlin's initial skepticism was replaced by a more cautious approach once the decision was made.

item.title: Trump On US Seizing Iranian Oil From Ships In Hormuz
item.description: Trump compared the US to pirates regarding Iranian oil seizures from ships in Hormuz. He said the US is not playing games. "We're like pirates. We're sort of like pirates.

item.title: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon kill seven amid fragile ceasefire
item.description: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon killed seven people despite a fragile ceasefire. Attacks hit villages including Kfar Dajal and Lwaizeh. Lebanon's state-run National News Agency reported an airstrike on a car in the village of Kfar Dajal that killed two people, while another hit a home in the village of Lwaizeh killing three.

item.title: Israeli air strikes kill 10 people in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israeli air strikes killed 10 people in southern Lebanon. Drones and planes hit several towns despite a ceasefire since April 17. Drones and planes hit several towns despite 'ceasefire' since April 17 as Hezbollah pledges to continue its attacks.

item.title: Trump jokes U.S. Navy will take on Cuba on the way home from Iran
item.description: Trump joked the US Navy will take on Cuba after Iran. The administration is pressing Cuba for reforms. The Trump administration is in the midst of a monthslong campaign to press the Cuban government to make dramatic reforms.

item.title: NATO says ‘working’ with U.S. to ‘understand' decision to cut troops in Germany
item.description: NATO is working with the U. S. to understand its decision to cut troops in Germany. The move follows renewed criticism of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz by President Donald Trump. The U.

item.title: NATO assessing details of US troop withdrawal from Germany
item.description: The US plans to withdraw about 5,000 troops from Germany over six to 12 months amid a feud with European allies. US says it plans to pull about 5,000 troops out of Germany over next six to 12 months amid feud with European allies.

item.title: Trump says US Navy acting ‘like pirates’ to enforce Iran blockade
item.description: US President Trump compared the US Navy to pirates for enforcing the Iran blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. He said it was a profitable business. The US president says the ongoing naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is 'a very profitable business'.

item.title: Humpback whale 'Timmy' released in North Sea after weeks stranded off Germany
item.description: A humpback whale named Timmy was released in the North Sea after being stranded off Germany. A GPS transmitter was attached to track its location. Before the release, a GPS transmitter was reportedly attached to track the whale's future location.

item.title: OPEC+ agrees in principle on small oil output quota hike without UAE, sources say
item.description: OPEC+ agreed to a small oil output quota hike without the UAE. The hikes are largely symbolic due to halted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The output hikes are largely ‌symbolic for now, with most shipping ​through the Strait of Hormuz halted by the ⁠U. S.-Israeli war against Iran.

item.title: U.S. warns shipping firms they could face sanctions over paying Iranian tolls in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US warned shipping firms they could face sanctions for paying Iranian tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. About a fifth of the world's trade in oil and natural gas typically passes through the strait at the mouth of the Persian Gulf in peacetime.

item.title: Trump Warns Of More Oil Disruptions, US Aircraft Carrier Leaves Gulf
item.description: A US aircraft carrier left the Gulf as Trump warned of more oil disruptions. The US had been involved in a war against Iran with Israel. US Israel Iran War Ceasefire News LIVE Updates.

item.title: After Assad's fall, Syria's Kurds are left in limbo, feeling abandoned by the U.S.
item.description: Kurdish families in Syria struggle with loss and uncertainty after Bashar al-Assad's fall. They feel abandoned by the US allies they once fought alongside. Caught in limbo after the fall of Syria's Bashar al-Assad, Kurdish families struggle with cold, loss and uncertainty.

item.title: Jordanians Struggle as Mideast Wars Scare Tourists Away
item.description: Jordan's tourism high season was nearly wiped out as visitors canceled flights and tours. Though Jordan mostly sat out the conflicts, its tourism high season was nearly wiped out at popular sites.

item.title: After Trump’s Ousting of Maduro, Little Has Changed for Most Venezuelans
item.description: US officials plan to take over Venezuela's oil industry to bring prosperity, but many in Caracas are skeptical. U. S. officials say they will “unleash prosperity” by commandeering the oil industry.
